subject: Pilot packaging — seats vs timebox for Oceanside Health POC
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@oceansidehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Oceanside Health Procurement <procurement@oceansidehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot packaging — seats vs timebox for Oceanside Health POC

Markus —

Quick question as we approach the final week of the POC: Procurement is asking whether we can convert the remaining time-based weeks into a short seat-based arrangement or a blended credit package. TL;DR: they want predictability for budgeting but also the flexibility to surge for a couple of heavy integration days next month.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood offer a 3-week extension converted into a seat-based option (N engineers with reserved capacity) instead of pure timebox weeks?
- If we keep the timebox, is there a way to receive a small block of surge tokens/credits in case we spike?

We have a PO number we can issue quickly if terms are agreed — attaching the internal procurement request (they asked for line items). Happy to hop on a quick call today.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Director, Applied AI
Oceanside Health

Attachment: OH_procurement_request_Aug1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@oceansidehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging — seats vs timebox for Oceanside Health POC

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — this is doable and we have two pragmatic paths that have worked for similar customers. I captured numbers below so procurement can see line items quickly.

Option A — Short-term seat swap (predictable)
- Convert remaining 3 weeks into 3 temporary developer seats (reserved inference capacity)
- Seats include 150k token allotment per seat for the period; any overage billed at standard pilot rate
- Pilot discount: 15% off the equivalent timebox total if PO is issued this week

Option B — Timebox extension + surge credits (flexible)
- Add 3 additional calendar weeks to the pilot (same model/version)
- Include a 150k surge credit bundle for sudden spikes (use-anytime during extended period)
- Pilot discount: 10% on extension, plus capped overage protection (first 50k tokens at 50% off)

Internal note: If procurement pushes hard on price, we can consider a one-time 20% customer success credit (approval needed).

Next steps:
- Pick A or B (I can draft a short SOW amendment)
- If A, confirm # seats and start date; if B, confirm surge credit amount

If helpful, looping in Monica for PO/SOW cadence and Karthik for packaging/legal pointers.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, East
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging — seats vs timebox for Oceanside Health POC

Markus —

Thanks for the clear options. My recommendation (based on procurement behavior at similar customers): lead with Option A (seat swap) but surface Option B as a fallback. Concrete proposed offer to present to Oceanside:

Hybrid (preferred seller play)
- 2 reserved engineering seats for the 3-week period (reduced from 3 to make the price easier to accept)
- 120k shared surge credits available for the 3-week extension window
- 18% pilot discount on the converted timebox/seat line item
- One-time onboarding credit of 5% applied if they sign PO within 5 business days

Rationale: seats give procurement a line item they can budget against; surge credits address their flexibility ask. It also reduces our uplift exposure vs converting all weeks to seats.

If procurement counters on price, approved concession: additional 5% discount in exchange for a signed 6-month review commitment (not a revenue commit, just an operational review).

I can draft the SOW amendment and short PO line items. Markus — want me to include the surge-credit mechanics (how credits are consumed / admin contact)? Karthik — flag anything legal/packagingwise we should avoid.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Markus / Monica —

Thanks for the options and quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the hybrid approach and prefers the Hybrid (your proposed seller play). They asked for the following to be included on the PO/SOW:

- 2 reserved engineer seats, 3-week effective period (Aug 10 - Aug 31)
- 120k shared surge credits (usable within the 3-week window)
- 18% pilot discount on the converted seat/timebox line item
- Statement that surge credits expire at the end of the extension period

We will issue PO #6423 today and attach a signed page. Please add the short SOW amendment (one page) that lists model name/version to lock for the pilot and the surge-credit redemption flow.

Attaching PO stub for your legal/finance team to match.

Looking forward to the quick SOW so we can get procurement to finalize.

Best,
Sarah Liu
